snippet.title: Cralon - Official Gameplay Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at Cralon in this latest trailer for the upcoming 3D immersive sim dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics. Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, fight creatures, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out. Cralon will be available on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.
